operator-walkthrough.ref: Post-visit text PR (Draft D, Nour 2026-10-24 'go post-visit text'). Operator UI: Admin > Outreach > Reviews > Settings > 'Custom Message Template (Optional)'; the empty textarea's placeholder now reads the real default, built by shared/postVisitText.ts with the tokens: 'Hi {firstName}, it's Nick's Tire & Auto on Euclid. Thanks for coming in. If anything about the car feels off, text us here and we'll take care of it. If you have a minute, tell other Cleveland drivers how your visit went: {reviewUrl}', instead of the old 'thanks for trusting us with your {service}' line. The help line, the saved template and every other control are unchanged; a saved custom template still wins over the default. Customer side: the review-requests cron default (routers/reviewRequests.ts buildReviewMessage), the 7-day post-invoice-followup text and the 7-day booking text sent by Admin > Outreach > Follow-Ups > RUN FOLLOW-UPS (follow-ups.ts process7dReviewRequests) all send that string via the shop line; replies land in the admin Messages inbox (routes/webhooks/smsGateway.ts inbound -> smsMessages + ensureResponseObligation). Proof: client/src/__tests__/review-requests-template-placeholder.test.tsx (red on the old placeholder, then green), server/postVisitText.test.ts consumer assertions on the string handed to sendSms for all three sends. Not yet seen in the live admin: checked after deploy.

capability-ledger-updated.deferred: No docs/operations/capability-ledger.json entry covers the post-visit SMS wording: the entries that mention these files (sms-send-receipts, admin-closure-wave-20261002, receptionist-prompt-evolution-gate) are about send outcomes, queue closure and the receptionist prompt, none of which this PR changes. The service-file edits are wording only: services/invoiceReviewRequests.ts exports its existing greetingName helper (no behaviour change) and services/sms-scheduler.ts drops an unused import of the deleted reviewRequestSms. No procedure, table, cron, flag, audience, cap or cooldown is added or changed. Proof is server/postVisitText.test.ts (red first on the base for all three sends) and the touched-file runs (round 3: 11 files, 104 tests, exit 0; manager re-run 4 files, 55 tests, exit 0). A ledger entry for the post-visit text belongs with a production receipt: one sent post-visit text visible in smsMessages after deploy.
